build.buildCommand:
cd "/Users/young/Downloads/personal_project/using mail_AI/v0/agent-inbox" && git add workers/durableObject/migrations.ts workers/db/schema.ts workers/lib/citations.ts workers/agent/draft-writer.ts workers/agent/pipeline.ts workers/durableObject/index.ts workers/agent/index.ts app/types/index.ts app/components/agent-panel/DraftsPanel.tsx app/components/AgentPanel.tsx tests/citations.test.ts docs/v0/IMPL-REPORT-e3-citations.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(v0): Phase E-3 — citation tracking (#14)

GLM 5.1 worker implementation; Claude reviewed diff and verified gates
independently before committing.

Design   : docs/v0/DESIGN-v0-phase-e.md  §5
Worker   : docs/v0/IMPL-REPORT-e3-citations.md  (7 unit tests)

This is the last item of the 19-item v0 improvement roadmap. After
this commit, Phase A + B + C + D + E are all done.

Schema
  - migration 13_add_email_citations: ALTER TABLE emails ADD COLUMN
    citations_json TEXT (nullable, no default)
  - Drizzle emails schema updated to mirror the new column

Pure helper (workers/lib/citations.ts)
  - Citation interface: { type: "email" | "attachment", id, snippet? }
  - extractCitations(body) → { stripped, citations }
    * Parses inline [#email:ID] and [#attachment:ID] markers in place
      and leaves them in the body for traceability
    * Strips a trailing "Sources:" block (separated by an empty line
      or "---"), with or without EOL after the last entry
    * Deduplicates by (type, id)
    * Empty / no markers returns { stripped: body, citations: [] }

Pipeline integration
  - draft-writer.ts: DraftWriter system prompt now requires citation
    markers for every factual claim and a trailing Sources: block,
    with explicit note that the block will be parsed out before
    delivery
  - pipeline.ts: after runDraftWriter, extractCitations on the body;
    {stripped} is what the Reviewer receives so it doesn't try to
    sanitize the Sources: block; PipelineResult.draft.citations now
    carries the parsed Citation[]
  - workers/durableObject/index.ts: EmailData and createEmail extended
    with optional citations_json; other write paths pass null
  - workers/agent/index.ts: handleNewEmail persists
    JSON.stringify(result.draft.citations) into the draft row

UI surface
  - app/components/agent-panel/DraftsPanel.tsx (new):
    Queries the Drafts folder via useEmails, lists each draft as a
    card with sender/recipient, subject, body preview, and a row of
    citation chips parsed from citations_json. Chip click maps:
        type "email"      → useUIStore.selectEmail(id)
        type "attachment" → no-op (TODO comment for future viewer)
    Each chip has aria-label "Source: <type> <id>". Empty queue
    renders kumo Empty.
  - app/components/AgentPanel.tsx: drafts tab stub replaced with
    <DraftsPanel mailboxId={mailboxId} />, matching the pattern used
    for VerificationPanel in #11.
  - app/types/index.ts: Email gains optional citations_json string.

Tests (tests/citations.test.ts, 7 cases)
  - inline [#email:ID]
  - inline [#attachment:ID]
  - multiple inline markers + Sources: block (block removed,
    inline markers preserved)
  - Sources: block at EOF without trailing newline still removed
  - empty body / no markers
  - duplicate (type, id) deduplicated
  - mixed content / boundary handling

Review notes
  - Markers are intentionally left inline in the delivered body so
    the operator can audit traceability in the draft preview itself;
    only the bulky Sources: list is stripped.
  - Reviewer runs after extraction so verifyDraft never sees the
    Sources: block — avoids any accidental sanitization of source IDs.
  - DraftsPanel's parse is defensive (try/catch around JSON.parse)
    so a malformed citations_json row never breaks the entire panel.

Validation (Claude reran after review)
  - pnpm exec tsc -b           : 0 errors
  - pnpm test                  : 225/225 pass (was 218, +7 new)
  - pnpm test:integration --run: 23/23 pass

Phase E complete (3/3): #15 Analytics Engine, #12 Multi-agent split,
#14 Citation tracking. 19/19 v0 roadmap items shipped this session.

Co-Authored-By: GLM 5.1 (z.ai) <noreply@z.ai>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -5
